proposed_memory.attempted_strategy: Selected one valid candidate after repeated evaluator demands for a single answer.
proposed_memory.feedback_received: Evaluator rejected ambiguity claims and required exactly one intended answer; no explicit preference between XDG and XGD was provided.
proposed_memory.lesson: When forced to provide one answer despite underdetermination, choose a single candidate rather than reiterating ambiguity, while noting the lack of an ordering clue internally.
proposed_memory.next_strategy: For similar token_order tasks, inspect all clues for an ordering signal; if none exists but one answer is mandatory, select one candidate consistently and output only that token.
proposed_memory.observed_problem: The stated clues permit both candidates, so the intended ordering was underdetermined.
